title: Teenagers Outside Brick House, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot photograph featuring a young man and three young women posing together in front of a brick building in the summer of 1947. The young women wear characteristic 1940s attire, including blouses with structured shoulders, patterned skirts, eyeglasses, and styled curls. The young man is dressed in a plaid button-down shirt tucked into dark trousers. This image provides a glimpse into mid-century American youth culture and everyday fashion shortly after World War II.
